# Rogues' Banquet

[**Rogues' Banquet**](https://www.compassboxwhisky.com/en-us/products/rogues-banquet)

Blended Scotch Whisky

46% ABV, Natural Colour, Not Chill-Filtered.

DetailsProcessFlavour

Rogues’ Banquet is a gastronomically-inspired Limited Edition, made for the gourmands and the hedonists who have accompanied us for the last two decades.

Rogues’ Banquet boasts flavours of softened tropical fruits, stem ginger and pastry cream. Fragrant yet full-bodied, it has a long and satisfying finish.

[Recipe & fact sheet](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0605/1990/7463/files/Rogues_Banquet_Recipe_Fact_Sheet_2020.pdf?v=1727337875)

## Fruity, Creamy & Luxurious

![](https://www.compassboxwhisky.com/cdn/shop/files/Rogues_Banquet_IWT.jpg?v=1727276729&width=1500)

## Join The Party

Rogues’ Banquet is a gastronomically-inspired Limited Edition, made for the gourmands and the hedonists who have accompanied us for the last two decades. It embodies the joyful possibilities – the delight and the indulgence – of dining together. We released Rogues' Banquet in March 2020, just as gatherings of people were first discouraged, with the hope that people would soon be able to enjoy each other's company again safely and pour something delicious at the same time.

![](https://www.compassboxwhisky.com/cdn/shop/files/Rogues_Banquet_FWB.jpg?v=1727276727&width=3840)

![](https://www.compassboxwhisky.com/cdn/shop/files/Recipe-Rogues.jpg?v=1722257174&width=1500)

## Recipe and Facts

Flavour profile


Rogues’ Banquet boasts flavours of softened tropical fruits, stem ginger and pastry cream. Fragrant yet full-bodied, it has a long and satisfying finish.

Recommendations


Reserve for future gatherings with those who are special to you, before pouring with a liberal hand.

A few drops of water will temper the whisky’s richness, allowing more delicate and exotic scents to emerge.

Technical details


Bottled at 46%.

Natural colour.

Not chill-filtered.

Blended Scotch Whisky.

A limited edition of 5,267 bottles.

February 2020.
